comment: What a `required:` clause may name, and what each resolves to as a scenario PREDICATE — a class of instances, never a reference to one. This file is the single source: resolvers load it rather than restating it. `<zone>_present` is generated per zone the contract declares.

inside_form.verifier_must: mount the component inside a form

expanded.note: the component declares an expanded/collapsed state

hover.verifier_must: drive a pointer over the element and hold it there
hover.note: an appearance-bearing interaction state; no prop declares it

focused.note: an appearance-bearing interaction state; distinct from `focus` as an observe type

lint: a condition naming `requires_prop` fails if no chapter declares that prop
a `<zone>_present` condition fails if §3.1 declares no such zone
